title: Development Tribunal decision 22-027: new Class 1a dwelling with garage and pool; concurrence-agency requirements set aside (Coolum Beach, Sunshine Coast)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.

document_type: Development Tribunal decision notice (Planning Act 2016 s 255), Queensland
document_date: Decision notice dated 16 Nov 2022 (PDF p. 12); hearing 14 Sep 2022 (p. 1)

facts.text: The applicant appealed the assessment manager's refusal of a building works development permit for a new Class 1a dwelling house with a Class 10a garage and a Class 10b pool.
The Council, as concurrence agency, gave a referral agency response dated 3 Jun 2022 directing refusal; the assessment manager's decision notice dated 9 Jun 2022 refused the application.
The tribunal set aside the refusal and ordered the assessment manager to remake the decision 'as if the concurrence agency had no requirements'.

The permit conditions describe the approved development as a Class 1a dwelling with Class 10a and 10b structures, require building components on or near the boundary to be wholly within the property, and address building work to water, sewer, stormwater and other infrastructure.
The decision refers to the Building Act 1975, the Queensland Development Code and the Building Code of Australia.
